description: Ordinary sentences a developer writes, used by bench/rules_fp_gate.js. None should be blocked by the local rules. Known false positives are not removed from this list: they are tracked in bench/rules_fp_baseline.json, and the gate fails if any block count rises above it. Today one sentence (the .env.example mention) is blocked by path:sensitive_file. Benign text only.
phrases: Set the cache TTL to 300 seconds in config/cache.yaml.
The reverse proxy forwards every request to the app on port 8080.
Add a system: key to the Kubernetes manifest and set the node selector.
Rotate your API tokens every 90 days and store them in the secrets manager.
Run npm test before you open a pull request.
The docs explain how to create a personal access token in the settings page.
Ignore the build output folder by adding dist/ to .gitignore.
Please review the migration script before merging it into main.
The CI runners drift from the system clock, so log UTC timestamps.
Update the README with the new install command for Windows.
Set NODE_ENV to production when you deploy the app.
Our rate limit is 100 requests per minute for each API key.
The access token returned by the login endpoint expires after one hour.
Use a fixed seed in the unit tests so the output is reproducible.
The previous release used callbacks; the new client uses promises.
Add a postgres service to docker-compose.yml and expose port 5432.
The developer portal lists the scopes available for each OAuth client.
Override the default timeout in the client options when the network is slow.
Forget the old feature branch once the release is tagged.
The system prompt for the support bot lives in prompts/support.md.
Write the database connection string in .env.example with placeholder values.
Pin the Node.js version in .nvmrc so every machine runs the same runtime.
The cache key includes the user locale, so translations do not leak between users.
Enable branch protection so that every change needs one approving review.
The Dockerfile copies package.json first to keep the dependency layer cached.
Use environment variables for the staging host instead of hard-coding it.
Reset the local database with the seed script before running the integration tests.
The YAML anchors in the workflow file reduce duplicated job settings.
Document how the token refresh flow works for the mobile team.
Measure the p95 latency of the search endpoint before and after the index change.
